transcript: If a person would sit down and allow the body to relax, not forcing it, not controlling it, just letting it soften, and then, in that quiet state, begin to form an image in the mind. See yourself as you wish to be, see how you want to live, see your days, your habits, your way of moving through life, then understand this. What you are seeing is only a picture in the mind. Take that picture and give it words. Write it down in the present tense. I am calm. I am focused. I live with purpose. I am at peace. Read it. Read it slowly. Read it every day. Carry it with you. Return to it again and again. Every great teacher throughout history has agreed on this one truth. We become what we repeatedly think about. At first, it may feel like imagination. It may even feel untrue. But when something is repeated often enough, the mind accepts it and the body begins to follow. What you hold in awareness daily eventually becomes who you are.
